rationale: The passport was damaged during the covered trip (June 28 to July 9, 2026), and the claim was filed within 90 days, so it falls under Section 6, Passport and Travel Documents, of wording 2026.1. Manual section 7 treats a loss to a wild animal such as a giraffe as accidental damage rather than theft, so no police report is needed, and the lodge letter and receipts support the claim. The Premium maximum of $250 is not exceeded and the passport benefit has no deductible, so the payout is the eligible total of $165 fee + $18 photos + $60 taxis = $243, which is within the $1,000 approval limit.
